[ Version: 1.01 ] 
 
 Too many battles where fought in this nearly dry river. Since UEF has build their base because of the strategic location, they faced uncountable attacks. 
 
 Note: This is a 3v3 2v2 map. Each player has at least 9 mexpoints for his own use: 4 (start) + 5 (surrounding) + # (Additional). Player 1 and 2 mexes are marked/underlaid with a rock/dirty decal.
